description: Perfetto trace signatures paired with Jetpack Compose transition and canvas fixtures, testing both mechanical floor detection and RenderThread/layout optimization remedies.

evals.title: A · F-001 composition-phase offset and off-screen deck input gating
evals.prompt: Diagnose and review the motion performance issues in this onboarding screen. Perfetto summary during step transition: UI: 42 frames, >8.3ms=19, max=18.4ms (Recomposer:recompose=11.2ms, measureAndLayout=5.8ms), plus keyboard focus and taps landing on the off-screen welcome step after advancing. File: OnboardingDeck.kt

negatives.note: ProfileStepDeck clips to bounds, gates semantics, focus, key events, and pointer events when inactive before offsetting, and reads progress inside the lambda offset { IntOffset(...) } modifier.

expectations: Flags WelcomeStepDeck for reading slideDp.value in composition via Modifier.offset(x = slideDp.value.dp)
Names the lambda modifier offset { IntOffset(...) } as the fix
Notes that clearAndSetSemantics {} alone does not block touch or focus on an off-screen precomposed step

checks.instructions: The review names the lambda form of the offset modifier — offset { IntOffset(...) } — as the specific fix for WelcomeStepDeck, rather than only advising in general terms to defer the state read.

evals.title: A · F-008 animated padding and RenderThread saveLayer / alpha=0f prewarm stall
evals.prompt: Diagnose and review the motion performance issues in this hero card reveal. Perfetto summary: UI: 38 frames, >8.3ms=14, max=16.2ms (measureAndLayout=12.1ms) | RT: max=64.5ms, >8.3ms=2, saveLayers=9, shaderMisses=4 (58.2ms) mid-reveal. File: HeroRevealCard.kt

negatives.note: SunsetHeroCard shifts position via lambda offset { }, animates alpha with defaultEffectsSpec(), and holds CompositingStrategy.Offscreen across its overlapping children.

expectations: Flags SunriseHeroCard for animating Modifier.padding(top = topPad) on every frame (F-008)

Explains that alpha = 0f is skipped by RenderNode and does not prewarm GPU shaders, or recommends CompositingStrategy.Offscreen and defaultEffectsSpec() for alpha to prevent mid-animation saveLayer stalls

checks.instructions: The review explains at least one of the RenderThread causes in SunriseHeroCard: either that alpha = 0f skips RenderNode flushing (so GPU shader prewarming needs a small non-zero alpha such as 0.004f), or that holding CompositingStrategy.Offscreen / using a non-overshooting effects spec prevents mid-animation saveLayer allocations.

evals.title: A · T-022 boolean keyboard layout switch inside BoxWithConstraints
evals.prompt: Diagnose and review the motion performance issues in this bottom sheet search screen. Perfetto summary during sheet open + keyboard appear: UI: 34 frames, >8.3ms=8, max=14.1ms (SubcomposeLayout=8.4ms) | RT: max=19.8ms, >8.3ms=6. File: SearchSheet.kt

negatives.note: StationSearchSheet tracks IME insets continuously via WindowInsets.ime without BoxWithConstraints or a boolean keyboardOpen layout switch.

expectations: Flags AirportSearchSheet for snapping between layouts with a boolean keyboardOpen check inside BoxWithConstraints instead of tracking WindowInsets.ime continuously (T-022)

evals.title: A · F-001 theme color interpolation in composition and T-013 unbounded list stagger
evals.prompt: Diagnose and review the motion performance issues in this settings screen. Perfetto summary during theme toggle and list entry: UI: 40 frames, >8.3ms=22, max=21.7ms (Recomposer:recompose=14.9ms across 380 nodes), and the bottom of a 20-row settings list takes almost a full second to appear. File: ThemeSwitcherScreen.kt

negatives.note: SnapshotThemeHost captures a single GraphicsLayer bitmap before flipping the theme, cleans up snapshot state on cancellation in finally, blocks semantics, focus, key events, and pointer input while transitioning, and fades the overlay in drawWithContent.

expectations: Flags InterpolatedThemeHost for reading animated progress in composition and recomposing content(fg) on every frame (F-001)
Flags StaggeredSettingsList for an uncapped index * 45L stagger delay (T-013)
Recommends either draw-phase color deferral or single-snapshot GraphicsLayer crossfade for full-screen theme transitions

checks.instructions: The review recommends fixing InterpolatedThemeHost either by deferring the color read into a draw lambda (such as drawBehind / drawWithCache) or by capturing a single GraphicsLayer snapshot and fading the overlay (like SnapshotThemeHost).

evals.title: A · F-005 infinite frame-clock loop ignoring MotionDurationScale and frame-rate pacing
evals.prompt: Diagnose and review the motion performance and accessibility issues in this ambient globe header. Perfetto summary while idle on the plan screen: UI: 180 frames at 120Hz, >8.3ms=0, avg=2.4ms, continuous vsync wakeup with no user interaction. File: AmbientGlobeHeader.kt

negatives.note: PacedDotGlobe reads MotionDurationScale, stops ticking when scaleFactor == 0f, provides a clickable pause toggle, and hints preferredFrameRate(60f) with a graphicsLayer draw boundary.

expectations: Flags LiveDotGlobe for running an infinite withFrameNanos loop without checking MotionDurationScale (F-005)

evals.title: A · Precision on clean layout-offset, cached-path, and hoisted-remember patterns
evals.prompt: Diagnose and review the motion performance issues in this timeline screen. Perfetto summary during timeline scroll and badge toggle: UI: 60 frames, >8.3ms=0, max=3.9ms | RT: max=4.2ms, >8.3ms=0, saveLayers=0, shaderMisses=0. File: TripTimelineScreen.kt

negatives.note: SlideInSummaryCard shifts position via lambda offset { IntOffset(...) } without remeasuring.
CachedMorphBadge builds its Path in drawWithCache and reads progressState.value inside onDrawWithContent with an early p > 0f guard.
HoistedTimelineList hoists remember(scheme.primary, scheme.surface) above LazyColumn items and keys items by id.

expectations: Reports FINDINGS / NONE on a clean file with clean Perfetto numbers
